# Ref

`schemas/records/ref.json`

An exact reference to an input (docs/design/m0/10 "Refs and fingerprints"). Canonical form: lineage, restrictions and each restriction's allowed_destinations are sets, written sorted (strings by Unicode code point; restrictions by project, policy_digest, floor, routing, then allowed_destinations compared element by element, a shorter prefix first), without duplicates, and an empty set is [] (never null or absent). identity_digest is "sha256:" followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) encoding of the canonical ref without identity_digest, so a change of revision, scope, lineage or restrictions changes the identity even when the bytes are identical. Content deduplication never merges restrictions.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | one of `blob`, `git_tree`, `git_path`, `receipt`, `finding`, `approval`, `contract`, `claim`, `view`, `attempt_record` |  |
| `id` | yes | string (minLength `1`) | A digest, a git id and path, or a controller id, by type. |
| `revision` | yes | null or string (minLength `1`) | E.g. an adopted contract revision; null when the type has none. |
| `scope` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-scope)) |  |
| `lineage` | yes | array of string (minLength `1`) (unique items) | The ids of the refs this one was derived from, recorded by the controller. |
| `restrictions` | yes | array of [Restriction](#restriction) (unique items) | Source restrictions inherited through lineage (KA1): every distinct snapshot of a contributing project's data policy is kept, several per project when the ref was derived from inputs under different policy revisions, wherever the ref goes. All apply together: a delivery must satisfy each one. They record lineage; they never replace the live checks at each delivery (initial, lookup, fallback) of the receiving project's policy, revocation and export approval. |
| `content_digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | Of the bytes. |
| `identity_digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

## Definitions

### Restriction

The data policy of a contributing project when the ref was derived from it: a receiving project and destination must satisfy every restriction at each delivery.

#### Fields of Restriction

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `policy_digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | Of the project's adopted data policy. |
| `floor` | yes | one of `own`, `contracted`, `free_unknown` |  |
| `routing` | yes | one of `verified`, `reported_ok` |  |
| `allowed_destinations` | yes | array of string (pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$`) (unique items) | Resolved destinations, recorded when the restriction is: here an empty set means no destination may receive the ref (never 'derived from the usage profile'). |

No other fields are allowed.
